shortTitle: Data-driven Subtypes of Youth-onset Type 2 Diabetes in Journal of Diabetes and Its Complications
longTitle: Data-driven subtypes of newly diagnosed youth-onset type 2 diabetes in the USA
summary:
In this paper, we identified three data-driven subtypes of youth-onset type 2 diabetes from the SEARCH and TODAY longitudinal studies. The subtypes were associated with distal symmetric polyneuropathy at diagnosis.

An independent study from Kreinkamp et.al. also observed similar findings.
citation: Guo J., Li Z. et.al. Data-driven subtypes of newly diagnosed youth-onset type 2 diabetes in the USA. Journal of Diabetes and its Complications. 2025. 40(1):109207. doi: 10.1016/j.jdiacomp.2025.109207
